Sam (People Ops): Quick note 1: guest drop-in this afternoon at 2:30pm (Eli from Fathom). There's a small box and a bouquet for them at the desk. Anyone available to escort?
Front Desk (Bot): Package logged: 1x small box, 1x bouquet for Eli. Badge preprinted.
Rina: I can grab them and wait in lobby until 2:25.
Carlos: Will free up at 2:20 and can meet in lobby.
Sam (People Ops): Thanks Rina 26 Carlos. Could someone put "Eli (Fathom)" on the meeting whiteboard and reserve Huddle A for 2:30-3:00?
Nina: Huddle A is booked for a 2:15 check-in but finishes at 2:30. Maybe Conf A?
Rina: Conf A is open. I'll put name on the board.
Carlos: I'll bring water and a spare HDMI dongle just in case.
Front Desk (Bot): Reservation created: Conf A 2:30-3:00. Items moved to holding locker #1. Escort assigned: Carlos.
Sam (People Ops): Parking reminder: permit code 4XS9 valid in visitor lot until 4pm.
Nina: Noted. Also FYI badge color for vendor visitors is blue sticker; IT has been informed for network guest access.
Carlos: Meeting room set and escorting now.
Rina: Bouquet looks amazing :flower: will leave it in the room on arrival.
Sam (People Ops): Thanks team! Please add any follow-ups here if needed.
Carlos: All done, guest checked in smoothly.
Sam (People Ops): Closing thread 1 :raised_hands:
